comments.text: Tibetans carry a genetic code inherited from the extinct Denisovans, allowing them to breathe easily on the "roof of the world" without their blood thickening. But the tragic reality is that this giant "water tower" feeding 2 billion Asians is melting at an alarming rate. The recent catastrophic floods are just a warning bell. No matter how extraordinary human genetics are, we can hardly fight climate change! 💧🏔
